{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Remove refunded orders (status == 'refunded')
filtered_df = df[df['status'] == 'completed']

# Check the distribution of customer_segment by channel
segment_by_channel = pd.crosstab(filtered_df['channel'], filtered_df['customer_segment'])
print('Customer segment distribution by channel:')
print(segment_by_channel)

# Compute conversion rate within each segment
conversion_by_segment_channel = filtered_df.groupby(['channel', 'customer_segment'])['converted'].mean().unstack(level='customer_segment')
print('\nConversion rate by channel and segment:')
print(conversion_by_segment_channel)

# Also check overall conversion rate by segment to understand baseline
conversion_by_segment = filtered_df.groupby('customer_segment')['converted'].mean()
print('\nOverall conversion rate by segment:')
print(conversion_by_segment)"}
